# SetWriter

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Output` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class SetWriter
```

Writes a generated collection to disk: the images, both metadata files per asset, and the Set manifest — and reads an existing Set back so `extend` can add to it.

```csharp
public const string GeneratorVersion = "nfty/1.0";
```

The engine stamp written into every Set manifest.

### TypeTrait { #f-typetrait }

```csharp
public const string TypeTrait = "Type";
```

The pseudo trait-type under which an asset's Recipe is published, alongside its real ingredient traits. It shares a namespace with ingredient *names* in both the OpenSea attributes and the rarity table, so an Ingredient actually named "Type" collides with it and double-counts — which shipped as a `rarityPct` above 100 and a duplicated row.

Public because [`Validator`](Nfty.Core.Formats.Validator.md) reserves the name on this constant's authority rather than repeating the literal. Rejecting the book is the fix rather than disambiguating the key, because the two are genuinely indistinguishable once written: on extend, the recipe trait is read back from `metadata/NNNN.json` as the plain string "Type", with nothing left to tell it apart from an ingredient of that name.

### ReadExisting(string, Parallelism?) { #m-readexisting-system-string-nfty-core-parallelism }

```csharp
public static SetWriter.ExistingSet ReadExisting(string outDir, Parallelism? parallelism = null);
```

Reads what an existing Set already holds, for extend.

**Parameters**

- `outDir` (`string`) - The Set folder.
- `parallelism` (`Parallelism?`) - How wide the per-file parsing may run; null means [`Parallelism.Default`](Nfty.Core.Parallelism.md#p-default). The result never depends on it.

**Returns.** Its DNAs and the next free number. An empty Set yields no DNAs and number 1.

**Exceptions**

- [`CorruptSetException`](Nfty.Core.Output.CorruptSetException.md) - An item file is unreadable or missing its fields.

### Write(GeneratedSet, string, bool, IAssetModeler?, IProgress&lt;WriteProgress&gt;?, CancellationToken, Parallelism?) { #m-write-nfty-core-generation-generatedset-system-string-44dd99 }

```csharp
public static void Write(GeneratedSet set, string outDir, bool pack, IAssetModeler? models = null, IProgress<WriteProgress>? progress = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default, Parallelism? parallelism = null);
```

Writes a Set.

**Parameters**

- `set` (`GeneratedSet`) - The generated collection.
- `outDir` (`string`) - Destination folder; created if missing.
- `pack` (`bool`) - Also zip the folder into a `.set` archive inside it, beside the images.
- `models` (`IAssetModeler?`) - Turns each asset into 3D model files under `models/`; null writes none. A Set is modeled whole or not at all, so extending one needs the same options.
- `progress` (`IProgress<WriteProgress>?`) - Receives one report per asset, one at a time, in increasing order.
- `cancellationToken` (`CancellationToken`) - Cancels the write.
- `parallelism` (`Parallelism?`) - How wide to write; null means [`Parallelism.Default`](Nfty.Core.Parallelism.md#p-default). The files are byte-identical at any degree.

**Exceptions**

- `InvalidOperationException` - The Set already on disk was modeled differently, or a modeler named a file outside `models/`.

### WriteAsync(GeneratedSet, string, bool, IProgress&lt;WriteProgress&gt;?, CancellationToken, IAssetModeler?, Parallelism?) { #m-writeasync-nfty-core-generation-generatedset-system-st-dc050a }

```csharp
public static Task WriteAsync(GeneratedSet set, string outDir, bool pack, IProgress<WriteProgress>? progress = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default, IAssetModeler? models = null, Parallelism? parallelism = null);
```

Writes the set with genuinely async I/O, reporting one [`WriteProgress`](Nfty.Core.Output.WriteProgress.md) per asset. Behaves exactly as [`SetWriter.Write()`](Nfty.Core.Output.SetWriter.md#m-write-nfty-core-generation-generatedset-system-string-44dd99) — same files, same bytes.

**Parameters**

- `set` (`GeneratedSet`) - The generated collection.
- `outDir` (`string`) - Destination folder; created if missing.
- `pack` (`bool`) - Also zip the folder into a `.set` archive inside it.
- `progress` (`IProgress<WriteProgress>?`) - Receives one report per asset, one at a time, in increasing order.
- `cancellationToken` (`CancellationToken`) - Cancels the write.
- `models` (`IAssetModeler?`) - As for [`SetWriter.Write()`](Nfty.Core.Output.SetWriter.md#m-write-nfty-core-generation-generatedset-system-string-44dd99); last so every existing call site is unchanged.
- `parallelism` (`Parallelism?`) - As for [`SetWriter.Write()`](Nfty.Core.Output.SetWriter.md#m-write-nfty-core-generation-generatedset-system-string-44dd99).
